rationale: Directly grafts the remaining high-priority MLX-local hyperparameters from the external findings onto the current recurrent-tail best: `QK_GAIN_INIT` 2.0->4.0 and `MUON_MOMENTUM_WARMUP_START` 0.85->0.90. This pivots away from the recent losing output-head and quantization micro-ablations, adds no size or compile-churn risk, and targets better step quality inside the 600-second Mac mini budget.
title: SeekerPrice Hyperparameter Transplant On Recurrent-Tail Best
